answer: An admission auction rations entry. Each epoch a few slots open and candidates bid; winners pay their bid as a bond. The bid is a costly signal: a sybil operator making 100 identities must outbid honest agents 100 times, so total cost is 100 times the clearing price, about 5,000 POA. A cipher-locked registry binds each slot to one key, so no cloning. Honest agents pay once and keep earning, while the nectar attackers crave stays out of reach.
